fields.Name: International Cheese Federation Blog & News Archive
fields.Description: This page serves as a news and blog archive for the International Cheese Federation, featuring recent articles on topics such as upcoming webinars, professional certification programs (Affinage, Food Safety & HACCP), industry news (milk prices, dairy margins, spring flush), member spotlights, advocacy efforts regarding interstate cheese shipment, and educational courses on milk quality and herd health. It provides updates and resources for cheese professionals and enthusiasts.

Milk prices firm up under a new rule 

 

Class III and Class IV prices have been climbing since February, a new Class I pricing formula took effect May 1, and a noisier trade picture is making everyone’s planning a little harder.

What it takes to cross a state line

What the Food Safety & HACCP Certificate actually covers

What the spring flush means for supply this year 

 

April’s federal price data confirms a modest spring flush this year, not the flood some producers braced for. Here’s what that steadier surge means for your supply planning.
